why: The store's civil-code view skips articles 33 to 53. Wanted the legal person's capacity to sue and its representative (and the neighbouring 49 and 51), to read around the petition particular on legal persons (CPCA 15, item 4).
Age of majority, discernment and capacity (articles 40 to 44, to which Family Code 82, 83 and 86 refer), to read around the nullity for a party's lack of capacity (CPCA 64 and 65).
Legal aid ordinance referred to by Law 90-04 article 25 and behind CPCA 17 ('unless the law provides otherwise') and 417: conditions of the exemption from judicial fees.
The texts fixing the judicial fees CPCA 17 and 418 refer to (amounts and statutory exemptions, finance and registration laws); not in the store.
